editorial:
Imagine you are an ex-cop who just wants to find a missing girl, but instead, you stumble into a creepy cult that believes in a monster called the Empty Man. The movie starts with a very long, strange sequence in the mountains that sets a heavy mood before jumping into the main story. You will feel the tension build up as the main character finds weird clues and meets people who seem to be losing their minds. It feels like a dark puzzle where you are trying to figure out what is real and what is just a trick of the mind.

What really works here is how the movie plays with your head. The acting is solid, and the twists are genuinely surprising, though the slow start might bore some people. If you like movies that make you think and feel uneasy, you will love this one.
endingExplained: You find out that the main character was actually a puppet for the monster the whole time. The entity uses people to build a path to our world. In the final scenes, the man realizes he is not the hero saving the day, but the tool helping the monster arrive. He eventually becomes the new Empty Man, meaning the cycle just starts all over again with a new victim.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves weird cult stories and psychological twists.
